ios.desc:
CountMediQ — the fastest pill counter for pharmacists.
Stop counting tablets by hand. Point your camera, and CountMediQ instantly counts pills, tablets, and capsules with AI image recognition — accurate 
enough for dispensing, fast enough for a busy pharmacy counter.

Why pharmacists choose CountMediQ
  • Live Mode — real‑time counting through the camera preview. Tap the shutter only when you need to lock the result.
  • One‑shot Photo Count — snap a tray, get the count in under a second.
  • PDF Count Report — share a clean, printable report with a patient, doctor, or your inventory team.
  • Counting History — every count is saved and searchable. Review past dispenses anytime.
  • Works on any tablet shape — round pills, oblong tablets, capsules, blister packs.
  • Multi‑language — English, 한국어, 日本語, 中文.

 Built for real pharmacy workflows
 Whether you're dispensing a prescription, doing a shelf audit, or organizing a patient's weekly medication, CountMediQ replaces the manual 
tray‑and‑spatula count with a camera shot.

Download CountMediQ — the pill counter, tablet counter, and medication counter pharmacists actually use.
Key features:

pill counting from a photo
Fast counting for large quantities
Save counted photos with notes and drug names
Review recent counts and library history
Share counting results
Cloud backup and restore for subscribed users
Monthly and yearly subscription plans for extended usage
CountMediQ is suitable for users who want a faster and more convenient way to count medication.

Notes:

Some features may require a subscription
Subscription prices and availability may vary by country
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled before the renewal date
